messages:
alex: Heads-up — trying to create invoice for Acme Widget Co (acct: acct-9876) and it's being blocked by procurement. System returns: "PO required before invoice issuance". Invoice draft ID INV-2026-0042 stuck.

maria_billing: Thanks Alex. Is this a new account setting or did procurement change their rules?

george_sales: Acme told George this morning they have a company-wide Net30 policy and procurement now demands a signed PO on file. They shared a PO number but not the signed doc.

jessica_procurement: @george_sales correct — we received PO# PW-4302 but procurement needs a signed PDF matching the PO number before invoices are generated. They said legal wants the signature on page 2.

alex: Got it. The billing UI shows a flag on the customer profile: `require_po_before_invoice: true`. Current account metadata: `po_number: PW-4302` but `po_signed: false`. The invoice workflow blocks when `po_signed` != true.

maria_billing: That's expected behavior. We can either (A) accept an uploaded signed PO to flip `po_signed=true` or (B) issue a one-off invoice that bypasses the rule (requires finance approval). Which path does Acme want?

george_sales: They're pushing procurement to send the signed doc ASAP. But they asked if we can issue the invoice this week to avoid late payment on their side.

alex: Do we have a documented process for manual override? If so I'll route to finance.

maria_billing: Manual override steps: 1) finance@redwood needs the signed PO + confirmation email from the customer contact. 2) Create invoice in our internal Billing Console -> Invoices -> Create (select `force_issue=true`) 3) Mark `audit_note: manual issue due to procurement delay` and route to collections. It requires Manager sign-off.

billing-bot: [automated] Billing rule applied: PO_REQUIRED flag enforced for acct-9876 since 2025-11-05. Attempts to auto-issue halted: 3 retries.

jessica_procurement: I can request the signed PDF now. George, can you confirm the contact and the email thread?

george_sales: Contact is sam.taylor@acmewidgets.com. I already pinged them: "please attach signed PO (page 2 signature) to the vendor portal or reply to this thread."

alex: FYI — if procurement supplies a signed PO that contains a different PO number, our ingestion script will reject it (we match `po_number` strict). Ask them to include PW-4302 in the document header or the body.

jessica_procurement: Noted. I'll ask them to reupload with the PO number visible. Also ask Sam if they can CC finance@acme to speed legal countersignature.

maria_billing: If getting the signed doc will take >48h and the customer insists, I'll escalate to Finance for manual issue. Alex, can you collect the existing email thread + any proof of purchase to attach to the request?

alex: Will do. Captured the thread and screenshot of the billing UI. Uploading to the finance ticket now.

billing-bot: [automated] Finance ticket created: FIN-5421. Assignee: maria_billing. SLA: 2 business days for review.

maria_billing: Assigned. FYI, finance will need: signed PO PDF, customer contract reference (CTR-2025-160), and a short justification.

george_sales: Sam replied: "We're attaching the signed PO now, had a signing delay on our side. File attached."

alex: Received the PDF and verified: PW-4302 present on page 1, signature appears on page 2. I uploaded to the account and set `po_signed=true`.

maria_billing: Confirming receipt. I see `po_signed` toggled. Will run the invoice creation job now.

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice generation job started for acct-9876, draft INV-2026-0042.

maria_billing: Invoice issued: INV-2026-0042 -> emailed to sam.taylor@acmewidgets.com. Payment terms Net30. Marking FIN-5421 resolved.

jessica_procurement: Great — I'll update procurement records to show signed PO received. Thanks all.

george_sales: Sam replied: :thumbsup: "Thanks, team — received the invoice"

alex: Closing here. Notes uploaded to support ticket: link to FIN-5421, copy of signed PO, and audit note `manual review not required — automated flow resumed`.

maria_billing: If anyone sees this repeat for other accounts, reminder: require_po_before_invoice enforces strict PO number + signature; we can expedite with a signed doc or finance override.

alex: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
